archive_links_duality_check.name: archive_links_duality_check
archive_links_duality_check.value:
(("file_version_id" is not null and "source_type" is not null and "source_type" <> 'report' and "source_id" is not null)
        or ("file_version_id" is null and "source_type" in ('report', 'meeting', 'travel', 'funding', 'expense') and "source_id" is not null))

meeting_participants_duality_check.name: meeting_participants_duality_check
meeting_participants_duality_check.value: (("user_id" is not null and "external_name" is null) or ("user_id" is null and "external_name" is not null))

time_entries_minute_order_check.name: time_entries_minute_order_check
time_entries_minute_order_check.value: "start_minute" is null or "end_minute" is null or "end_minute" > "start_minute"
